text: A grove guardian twisted by a severed ley line. Slow but sturdy.
Rootbound lurk in Overworld forests, and on the March Steppe and in the Reed Fen.
It has **38 health** and **5 armour** and hits for **6**. Each blow roots you, slowing you for 3 seconds. It is slow itself, so step back, wait out the roots, and strike again.
pages.title: Where and how

text: A Knotted Root attunes into 2 Attuned Echoes under Spirit.
pages.title: What it gives

text: No charm will bond a Rootbound.
